a6348:
# home-glance: the two-second glance at the top left of the home base (a6057, the HUD sprint's lane 3, LAMPLIT). The time,
# then one sentence of the state of everything, in numbers: what waits on you (amber, the only warm colour on the
# screen), who is at work this moment (mint: something alive), then the machine's queue in grey. A count of nothing is
# left out, so the sentence is as short as the day is quiet; when nothing waits on you it says so, faint.
# Round 2 (borrowed from lane 2, a5994: full= on the layout): each number is also the way in. A press fills the room
# with the panel that answers it (a press again gives the room back), taking it off the shelf if it was there. Which
# panel answers is the panel's own tag: glance-you, glance-work, glance-board (one panel may answer several: lane 1's
# inbox answers you and board), so whichever panel Alex keeps claims a number by one tag, and this lens names none. A
# number no panel claims is still said; it just opens nothing. When two panels claim one (Waiting on you and lane 1's
# inbox both answer 'you'), the one that is out wins (by shelf: no before yes), else the first in the room.
# What waits on you is counted as lane 1's NEEDS YOU counts it (a6010, round 2): a look, a design waiting on your word,
# and a stuck commission you asked for (one a resident asked for is JEFF's to answer); kept the same as the panel it
# opens, so the two numbers always agree.
# A widget: tag widget, slot=bar, order=1 (it takes the clock's place: home-clock is untagged where this is worn).
glance : row
 role lgband
 let you = count(tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=$me,-prop:review=later)
 let busy = count(house doing=working)
 let queued = count(prop:commission=asked)
 let ready = count(prop:commission=ready)
 let landing = count(prop:commission=landing)
 let youword = "waits on you" when you = 1
 let youword = "wait on you" otherwise
 clock : column
  role lgclock
  time : text "$today"
   live clock
   role lgtime
  day : text "$today"
   live date
   role lgday
 sentence : row
  role lgsentence
  lays : row
   role lgsentence
   of prop:role=home-layout,prop:actor=$me as lay
   each stats
  plain : text "$(you) $(youword) · $(busy) at work"
   role lgword
   only when count(prop:role=home-layout,prop:actor=$me) = 0
stats : row
 role lgsentence
 let byou = count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-you)
 let bwork = count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-work)
 let bboard = count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-board)
 you : row
  only when you > 0
  of prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-you as p
  by shelf
  each youstat
 youplain : row
  role lgstat
  only when you > 0 and byou = 0
  n : text "$(you)"
   role lgnum.you
  w : text "$(youword)"
   role lgword.you
 calm : text "nothing waits on you"
  role lgcalm
  only when you = 0
 busy : row
  only when busy > 0
  of prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-work as p
  by shelf
  each busystat
 busyplain : row
  role lgstat
  only when busy > 0 and bwork = 0
  n : text "$(busy)"
   role lgnum.lit
  w : text "at work"
   role lgword.lit
 queued : row
  only when queued > 0
  of prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-board as p
  by shelf
  each queuedstat
 queuedplain : row
  role lgstat
  only when queued > 0 and bboard = 0
  n : text "$(queued)"
   role lgnum
  w : text "queued"
   role lgword
 ready : row
  only when ready > 0
  of prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-board as p
  by shelf
  each readystat
 readyplain : row
  role lgstat
  only when ready > 0 and bboard = 0
  n : text "$(ready)"
   role lgnum
  w : text "ready to land"
   role lgword
 landing : row
  only when landing > 0
  of prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,tag:glance-board as p
  by shelf
  each landingstat
 landingplain : row
  role lgstat
  only when landing > 0 and bboard = 0
  n : text "$(landing)"
   role lgnum
  w : text "landing"
   role lgword
# one number and its words; pressed, the room is its panel's (or given back)
youstat : row
 role lgstat
 role lgstat.on when $item = ($lay.full or "")
 only when $index = 1
 let was = ($lay.full or "")
 let out = ($p.shelf or "")
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") = "yes" do prop $p shelf=no; do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") != "yes" do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item = ($lay.full or "") do prop $lay full=""
 n : text "$(you)"
  role lgnum.you
 w : text "$(youword)"
  role lgword.you
busystat : row
 role lgstat
 role lgstat.on when $item = ($lay.full or "")
 only when $index = 1
 let was = ($lay.full or "")
 let out = ($p.shelf or "")
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") = "yes" do prop $p shelf=no; do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") != "yes" do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item = ($lay.full or "") do prop $lay full=""
 n : text "$(busy)"
  role lgnum.lit
 w : text "at work"
  role lgword.lit
queuedstat : row
 role lgstat
 role lgstat.on when $item = ($lay.full or "")
 only when $index = 1
 let was = ($lay.full or "")
 let out = ($p.shelf or "")
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") = "yes" do prop $p shelf=no; do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") != "yes" do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item = ($lay.full or "") do prop $lay full=""
 n : text "$(queued)"
  role lgnum
 w : text "queued"
  role lgword
readystat : row
 role lgstat
 role lgstat.on when $item = ($lay.full or "")
 only when $index = 1
 let was = ($lay.full or "")
 let out = ($p.shelf or "")
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") = "yes" do prop $p shelf=no; do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") != "yes" do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item = ($lay.full or "") do prop $lay full=""
 n : text "$(ready)"
  role lgnum
 w : text "ready to land"
  role lgword
landingstat : row
 role lgstat
 role lgstat.on when $item = ($lay.full or "")
 only when $index = 1
 let was = ($lay.full or "")
 let out = ($p.shelf or "")
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") = "yes" do prop $p shelf=no; do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item != ($lay.full or "") and ($p.shelf or "") != "yes" do prop $lay full=$p
 on click when $item = ($lay.full or "") do prop $lay full=""
 n : text "$(landing)"
  role lgnum
 w : text "landing"
  role lgword
a5548:
# home-board: the board, one panel of the home base (a5674). The HUD sprint's lane 1, round 3 (a6010): an inbox. NEEDS
# YOU (what waits on Alex: things to look at, designs waiting on his word, his own stuck commissions; it answers what
# waiting-on-me did), IN MOTION, LANDED, one line per card. A line says what it is (brief= when the card has one, else
# its title), how far along (a word at the right edge, and since when) and, on a line that needs Alex, its answer: one
# press, never typing (Looks good, Send back, Later; Build it on a design; Try again). Colour says whose move it is
# (LAMPLIT, lane 3): amber Alex's, lilac a resident's (what waits on JEFF folds into one line), mint an agent at work
# this moment; the rest grey, buttons white. A press anywhere else on a line opens it in place at once (the viewer's own
# fold): its track, who has it (names, never ids), its worker's latest word, Open in the middle, where its talk is
# (one box for words, the middle's; agreed with lane 3 in a6049). Roles: the nb* block in home-style.
board : column
  role nb
  views : column
    of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me as hv
    each bands
  lost : text "No viewer note for you here (role=home-view, actor=you): Open has nowhere to show a card."
    role hint
    only when count(prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me) = 0
bands : column
  role nbbands
  let nneed = count(tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,-prop:review=later)
  let nlater = count(tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,prop:review=later)
  let nmove = count(prop:commission=asked) + count(prop:commission=working) + count(prop:commission=ready) + count(prop:commission=landing)
  let njeff = count(prop:commission=waiting) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by!=alex)
  let nlanded = count(prop:commission=landed)
  let busy = count(house doing=working)
  need : column
    role nbband
    head : row
      role nbhead
      name : text "NEEDS YOU"
        role nbname.need
      n : text "$(nneed)"
        role nbcount.need
        only when nneed > 0
      gap : text ""
        share 1
      none : text "nothing waits on you"
        role nbquiet
        only when nneed = 0
    reviews : column
      role nbcards
      of tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later as c
      each review
    designs : column
      role nbcards
      of prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later as c
      each design
    failed : column
      role nbcards
      of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,-prop:review=later as c
      each failure
    later : column
      role nblater
      only when nlater > 0
      fold "Later · $(nlater)" handle nbfold
      a : column
        role nbcards
        of tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later as c
        each review
      b : column
        role nbcards
        of prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later as c
        each design
      f : column
        role nbcards
        of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,prop:review=later as c
        each failure
  move : column
    role nbband
    head : row
      role nbhead
      name : text "IN MOTION"
        role nbname
      n : text "$(nmove)"
        role nbcount
      gap : text ""
        share 1
      live : text "$(busy) at work now"
        role nblive
        only when busy > 0
    landing : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=landing as c
      each moving
    ready : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=ready as c
      each moving
    working : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=working as c
      each moving
    queued : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=asked as c
      each moving
    jeff : column
      role nbjeff
      only when njeff > 0
      fold "WAITING ON JEFF · $(njeff)" handle nbfold.jeff
      asking : column
        role nbrows
        of prop:commission=waiting as c
        each moving
      stuck : column
        role nbrows
        of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by!=alex as c
        each moving
  landed : column
    role nbband
    fold "LANDED · $(nlanded)" handle nbfold
    rows : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=landed as c
      each done
# a thing waiting on Alex's look: a note, a demo, a report (tagged ready-for-review)
review : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    ok : text "Looks good"
      role nbgo
      on click do tag $c remove=ready-for-review; do comment $c line="@jeff: looks good (from the board)"
    no : text "Send back"
      role nbaway
      on click do tag $c remove=ready-for-review; do comment $c line="@jeff: not yet: send this back (from the board)"
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
    back : text "Now"
      role nbaway
      only when $c.review = "later"
      on click do prop $c remove=review
  body : column
    role nbbody
    facts : row
      role nbtop
      kind : text "to look at"
        role nbwhen
      demo : text "· a demo inside"
        role nbwhen
        only when ($c.demo or "") != ""
      when : text "· waiting since $(day-or-time($changed.tags, $today))"
        role nbwhen
        only when ($changed.tags or "") != ""
    gist : text "$c.text"
      role nbgist
      clamp 4
      only when ($c.text or "") != ""
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# a design waiting on Alex's word: Build it is his word in one press (design=answered verdict=build, and a line in its
# own talk, which reaches its author); Later puts it off; Read it opens it in the middle
design : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    build : text "Build it"
      role nbgo
      on click when $c.design = "waiting" and ($c.talk or "") != "" do prop $c design=answered verdict=build; do append $c.talk line="Build it. (from the board)"
      on click when $c.design = "waiting" and ($c.talk or "") = "" do prop $c design=answered verdict=build; do comment $c line="@jeff: build it (from the board)"
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
    back : text "Now"
      role nbaway
      only when $c.review = "later"
      on click do prop $c remove=review
  body : column
    role nbbody
    by : text "a design by $(($c.by or "someone")), waiting on your word"
      role nbwhen
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      read : text "Read it in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# a commission Alex asked for that did not land and its worker could not mend: Try again starts its worker once more
failure : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    again : text "Try again"
      role nbgo
      on click when $c.commission = "failed" do prop $c commission=asked
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
  body : column
    role nbbody
    who : text "did not land; its worker could not mend it"
      role nbwhen
    last : column
      of comments:$c.item as m
      each note
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# one commission on its way: what, then at the right edge how far and since when; pressed, who has it and their word
moving : column
  role nbrow
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbrowtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    queued : text "queued"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "asked"
    live : text "working"
      role nbstage.live
      only when $c.commission = "working" and count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) > 0
    idle : text "working"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "working" and count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) = 0
    asks : text "asks JEFF"
      role nbstage.jeff
      only when $c.commission = "waiting"
    stuck : text "stuck"
      role nbstage.jeff
      only when $c.commission = "failed"
    ready : text "ready to land"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "ready"
    landing : text "landing"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "landing"
    since : text "$(day-or-time($changed.commission, $today))"
      role nbwhen
      only when ($changed.commission or "") != ""
  body : column
    role nbbody
    steps : row
      role nbsteps
      q : text "queued"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission != "asked"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "asked"
      w : text "working"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission = "ready" or $c.commission = "landing"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "working"
        role nbstep.jeff when $c.commission = "waiting" or $c.commission = "failed"
      r : text "ready"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission = "landing"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "ready"
      l : text "landing"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "landing"
      d : text "landed"
        role nbstep
    who : row
      role nbtop
      codex : text "a Codex builder"
        role nbname.link
        only when $c.worker_provider = "codex"
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      claude : text "a Claude builder"
        role nbname.link
        only when ($c.worker_provider or "") != "codex" and ($c.worker or "") != ""
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      owner : text "$c.owner"
        role nbname.link
        only when ($c.worker or "") = "" and ($c.owner or "") != ""
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      now : text "at work this moment"
        role nbnow
        only when count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) > 0
      jeff : text "· asked by JEFF"
        role nbwhen
        only when $c.asked_by = "jeff"
      for : text "· asked by $(($c.asked_by or "nobody"))"
        role nbwhen
        only when $c.asked_by != "jeff"
    # now= on a worker's own card: what it is doing this minute, in its own words (lane 3's proposal, a6049 c6262)
    now : text "$c.now"
      role nbnotetext
      clamp 2
      only when ($c.now or "") != ""
    last : column
      of comments:$c.item as m
      each note
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# the latest comment only (a clamp would print how many it cut, in the card)
note : column
  role nbnote
  only when $index = $count
  by : text "latest, from $m.by"
    role nbnoteby
  said : text "$m.text"
    role nbnotetext
    clamp 3
# the last five landed (by $index, not a clamp, which would print what it cut)
done : row
  role nbdone
  only when $index > $count - 5
  on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
  what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
    role nbdonetitle
    clamp 1
    share 1
  when : text "$(day-or-time($changed.commission, $today))"
    role nbwhen
    only when ($changed.commission or "") != ""
a566: Settings the house reads (props on this note): model, the model a resident runs on; breather, seconds between wakes while an objective is open; wake_every, seconds between wakes otherwise; timers, off when only a call may wake a resident (a comment, a reply, a worker report, an @): no objective, wake_every or timed-rest wakes (Alex, 13 Oct). A resident's corner carries want=awake or want=rest, and wake, the desk line it reads each time it wakes. The house writes status on each corner when it changes.
